messages:
Sam (Growth): Small, focused ask: need a 1
page benchmark infographic + hero tile for the webinar next Wed. Infographic must fit an A4 printable and a separate PNG for slides (16:9). Timeline: comps by Tue AM, final by Wed EOD.
Lee (PM): Priority order: 1) A4 infographic (print + web PDF) 2) hero social tile (1200x628) light/dark 3) slide PNG (1920x1080). Keep benchmark simple: single sparkline + 1 callout stat (cost delta).
Nora (Design): Copy tone? Also any mandatory legal copy or partner logos?
Sam (Growth): Tone = technical-friendly. No partner logos this round to keep legal overhead low. CTA: "Register". Headline: "Serve better LLMs 
 lower latency, lower cost."
Nora (Design): Good. Plan: 2 infographic comps (data-first and narrative-first), hero in two visual weights. Will include an "alt-text" draft for each asset and a one-line caption for social. Using Inter Var.
Tom (Legal): Quick compliance notes: • Add footer: "© 2026 Redwood Inference. All rights reserved." • Any benchmark claim needs a 1-line source note (e.g., "Based on internal e2e tests, Jan 2026"). Please leave space for that. No partner logos ok.
l10n-bot: Localization: create separate Figma pages for EN/FR/DE and export a UTF-8 CSV with keys. Plan for +25% text expansion for DE. Include context notes for translators.
Nora (Design): Accessibility: will ensure chart colors are colorblind-safe, body copy >= 4.5:1 contrast, headings >= 3:1; min 16px at 1080x1080. Export naming: `launch/servebetter/infographic-<variant>-A4-v1.pdf` and `launch/servebetter/hero-<variant>-1200x628-v1.png`.
Lee (PM): Also include a tiny handoff.txt in the zip with: Figma link, approved filenames, UTMs, alt-texts, copy CSV, and legal note. UTMs: campaign=serve-better-2026, source=paid_social|email, content=heroA|infogA.
Sam (Growth): Perfect. Nora ETA?
Nora (Design): Comps uploaded to Figma by Tue 9am PT, first PDFs by Tue PM, final handoff Wed EOD with localized pages and CSV. I'll @marketing when hero PNGs land. :sparkles:
